issues.description: Method addAnimal(Animal) has inconsistent return types across artifacts. In the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) the Farm method is declared as addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean (line 18). In the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) the method is implemented as public void addAnimal(Animal animal) (signature at line 23). The template's Main usage (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java lines 16-18) calls farm.addAnimal(...) without handling a boolean return. This mismatch between the UML and the implemented API can confuse students about the expected method signature and whether they must return/handle a boolean value.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API contract consistent across artifacts. Preferred (minimal-change) fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare addAnimal(animal: Animal): void and update the task description to state that addAnimal does not return a value. Alternatively, if a boolean is intentionally required, change the template and solution Farm.addAnimal implementation to return boolean (e.g., return true on successful add) and update Main usage and documentation to handle the returned boolean.
